Class AbstractMemoryContext<CellType>

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.plugins.memory.AbstractMemoryContext<CellType>
Type Parameters:
CellType - the memory cell type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Context, MemoryContext<CellType>
@ThreadSafe public abstract class AbstractMemoryContext<CellType> extends Object implements MemoryContext<CellType>
This class implements some fundamental functionality of MemoryContext interface, that can be useful in the programming of the own memory context.

  • Field Details

    • listeners

      protected final Set<MemoryContext.MemoryListener> listeners
      List of all memory listeners. The listeners are objects implementing the IMemoryListener interface. Methods within the listeners are called on some events that happen inside memory (e.g. value change).

    • setMemoryNotificationsEnabled

      public void setMemoryNotificationsEnabled(boolean enabled)
      Description copied from interface: MemoryContext
      Enable/disable notifications of memory changes globally.

      Enabled by default. Usually it is disabled by CPU when in a "running" state.

      Specified by:
      setMemoryNotificationsEnabled in interface MemoryContext<CellType>
